title: Law to pilot low-traffic neighborhood zones
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to run a 2-year pilot installing at least two traffic calming devices, such as speed humps or curb extensions, in five neighborhoods across at least three boroughs to steer traffic away from residential streets. The department would have to consult local community boards on device placement and ensure access for emergency, delivery and sanitation vehicles and nearby residents. It would also study crash, injury, noise and complaint data in these areas and report findings and recommendations to the mayor and Council within six months of the pilot's end.
